purpose: Prepare, approve, and publish reusable social content through provider adapters while binding approval to the exact publishable content and keeping provider credentials outside tracked artifacts.
supported_use_cases: text-only member publication through a provider adapter
deterministic preview and content-hash approval binding
fail-closed handling when content changes after approval

runtime_boundary.secrets: OAuth client secrets, access tokens, refresh tokens, authorization codes, cookies, and browser/session state are runtime-only and must never be persisted in tracked source, fixtures, previews, or receipts.
runtime_boundary.private_content: Operator drafts may enter at runtime. Public fixtures use synthetic text only.

forbidden_core_assumptions: automatic publication without an explicit approval binding
non_goals: production publication in the P95 prototype
proof_ceiling: Executable P95 prototypes prove the provider-neutral approval seam, LinkedIn text-post request construction, success receipt, stale-approval failure, and provider-authorization failure using synthetic inputs and fake transport. Live OAuth, identity resolution, network publication, and production use remain unproven.
next_transition: P07 bounded implementation: add runtime OAuth/identity/HTTP transport behind the proved LinkedIn adapter seam, then perform one operator-approved controlled live text post.
